paragraphs.text: A Harness for Musical Interaction
# Tele
Interactive music tools for AI agents.
Tele v0.2.0 adds a DSH plugin for playable guitar chord boards and keeps Pi's board and private conv
ersation support. Ask the agent to change a chord progression, then click the chords to hear it. The
DSH plugin does not provide private chat, music mode, or an embedded DSH panel.
The npm instructions below target v0.2.0. Confirm that this version is available in the registry bef
tions below target v0.2.0. Confirm that this version is available in the registry before installing.
English | 简体中文
## Install the DSH board plugin
Tele v0.2.0 supports exactly DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`. It does not claim compatibility with other DSH versio
e v0.2.0 supports exactly DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`. It does not claim compatibility with other DSH versions.
In DSH's **Plugin Manager**, install the npm package spec `@kyn0v/pi-tele@0.2.0`. You can also ask y
our DSH agent to call `plugin_manager` with `action: install_bundle` and `target: @kyn0v/pi-tele@0.2
.0`. The npm package includes built server and browser files. You do not need a source checkout, a b
uild, or installation scripts. Inspect the returned activation outcome. A failed or restart-required
result does not mean the plugin is running.
### Develop from local source
To install a local checkout instead, prepare it in a shell:
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Use the Plugin Manager to install `/absolute/path/Tele`, or give that absolute directory as the agen
t's `install_bundle` target. After source updates, rebuild and follow the application's reported rel
oad or restart outcome. Linked plugins may reload through profile recomposition without a restart.
With either installation, ask the DSH agent to use `tele_board` to inspect the catalogue, read a boa
rd by `boardId`, then create or replace it with the current `expectedRevision` and complete `content
`. Open the returned URL manually in a browser on the DSH host; Tele does not open it automatically.
The browser is a separate local page, not a panel embedded in DSH, and it cannot read or send DSH c
hat. Its board-only capabilities (`chat: false`, `chatPanel: false`) hide the Pi conversation panel;
Pi and standalone page behavior remains unchanged.
DSH defaults to `dataDir: ~/.tele/dsh` (expanded to an absolute home path) and `port: 0` (a free por
t). Configure a nonempty absolute `dataDir` and an integer port from 0 through 65535 through the Plu
gin Manager. Boards are shared across sessions using the plugin in the profile and readable by calle
rs that can access its local service; do not store private conversation or secrets in them. The trus
ted plugin runs with the host user's permissions and does not provide an operating-system sandbox. S
ee the DSH integration reference for the tool contract and real-host checklist. `npm run verify:dsh`
builds and runs independent fixture checks; `npm run verify:dsh:live -- http://127.0.0.1:PORT/b/boa
rd` checks an existing live board read-only. Neither establishes the real DSH tool pipeline or Plugi
n Manager GUI metadata verification.

Local registration does not install dependencies or build files. Repeat `npm ci` and `npm run build`
after updating the source. Use only one loading method: package registration, project discovery, or

## Load from source in an existing Pi session
If you have not registered Tele as a package, Pi can discover it in this project. Install dependenci
es and build the browser files in a shell. Do not start a standalone Tele server at the same time.

## Privacy and limitations
Tele binds only to `127.0.0.1`. Board reads are public to callers that can access that local service
. Board writes require a local capability. The private-chat rules below apply to the Pi connection o
nly; the DSH plugin starts no chat bridge and restricts no other DSH tools. Pi private chat reads an
d commands require a paired browser cookie, scoped to one binding, with `HttpOnly`, `SameSite=Strict
`, and an eight-hour expiry. Pairing links expire after two minutes and can be used once. Detach, re
load, and session or branch replacement revoke the binding. Local HTTP has no TLS, and its cookie is
not `Secure`. Do not expose the service to the internet.
A paired browser can read user and assistant text from the selected branch. Tele excludes thinking,
system prompts, tool arguments and raw results, compaction summaries, and extension-private messages
. It cannot reliably filter secrets from ordinary messages. The browser shows at most 100 items and
about 256 KiB, with up to 32,768 UTF-16 code units per user or assistant item. It does not display a
ttachments. Pi remains the only store of the conversation history.
A submission receipt does not mean the model has accepted or answered the message. If Tele cannot co
nfirm what happened, it keeps the draft and does not resend it. Reconnecting reads the current state
without replaying commands. Stopping a reply does not undo saved board changes or answer terminal d
t replaying commands. Stopping a reply does not undo saved board changes or answer terminal dialogs.
Music mode is not an operating-system sandbox. Trusted extensions still run with Pi's user permissio
ns. Tele restricts model tool calls, not arbitrary extension code. Do not load untrusted extensions.
The prototype supports local use, standard six-string tuning, a fixed chord catalogue, and whole-boa
rd updates. Web Audio generates a plucked-string sound; it does not play recorded guitar samples. Te
le does not support capos, alternate tunings, chord editing, rhythm arrangement, cloud accounts, or
an MCP plugin. Boards persist across normal restarts. Atomic file replacement does not guarantee rec
overy after power loss or on network filesystems.
